name: manual_525d91
claim: Design the model-code sandbox deny-by-default and keep its allowlist narrow. An allow-by-default macOS profile left Apple Events, launch services and exec of other programs reachable; a read root computed as the parent of the interpreter binary becomes the home folder or / on some layouts. Allow reads only from exact prefixes and stdlib directories, refuse any root that is /, home, an ancestor of home or shallower than three components, layer secret-directory denials on top, allow only the interpreter to exec, and note that Python then needs only a read of the root directory entry. In the vet, refuse parameter defaults, variadics and any name that shadows a builtin, because a parameter named getattr with getattr as its default otherwise passes.
conditions: sandbox deny-by-default read roots allowlist vet shadowing builtins sandbox-exec

decisions.notes: 2026-11-17: three consecutive automated security reviews of sandbox_run each found a real flaw; each was reproduced, fixed test-first and covered by kernel-level tests (56 tests).
